# LingoVela: Live Translate — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> Focused two-way live voice conversation translator for iPhone and iPad pairing spoken output with dual-language transcripts and transparent switching between Cloud AI and 0-credit On-Device offline speech.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/lingovela-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/lingovela-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS 26+, iPadOS 26+ (Pre-Release)
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- Face-to-face split-conversation UI with synchronized dual-language transcripts on iPhone and iPad.
- Explicit capability matrix distinguishing Cloud AI voice translation from 0-credit On-Device offline speech packs.
- Zero mandatory account registration or external API key setup.

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://lingovela.arte-soft.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://lingovela.arte-soft.com/guides/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821890481): Official App Store listing by Arte Soft EOOD.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://lingovela.arte-soft.com/compare/): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://lingovela.arte-soft.com/guides/): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://lingovela.arte-soft.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
